hook_text: Pencil lead has no lead in it at all. So what is it?
clip_script: Braai day in Kroonstad. On the table: charcoal, matches, pencils, yellow sulfur and the metal braai grid. Shine test: the grid shines, the charcoal is dull. Hammer test: metal bends, charcoal crumbles. Brittle! Bend test: copper wire bends, pencil lead snaps. And pencil lead? It is graphite, a kind of carbon, just like the charcoal. Metals and non-metals: test the properties, then decide.
visual_style: Whiteboard table split into two columns, metal and non-metal, with each object tested and dropped into its column.
mood: Hands-on and cheerful, like a science braai.
pacing: One object at a time through three quick tests, then the pencil surprise.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and test five things in your kitchen.
